source_title: Keras Code Examples / NLP / English-to-Spanish translation with a sequence-to-sequence Transformer
chapter_or_section: Keras Code Examples / NLP / English-to-Spanish translation with a sequence-to-sequence Transformer
title: Implement and train a sequence-to-sequence Transformer for English-to-Spanish translation
instruction_text: Implement a sequence-to-sequence Transformer for English-to-Spanish translation using Keras. Vectorize the text with TextVectorization, prepare encoder and decoder inputs, implement TransformerEncoder, TransformerDecoder, and PositionalEmbedding, assemble the end-to-end model, train it on the translation dataset, and use the trained model to decode unseen input sentences.
expected_output: A trained sequence-to-sequence Transformer model for English-to-Spanish translation and decoded translations for unseen test sentences.
constraints: Use the English-to-Spanish dataset provided in the example.
Prepare data as encoder_inputs, decoder_inputs, and next-token targets.
Train and demonstrate inference on unseen sentences.
learning_objectives: Implement core Transformer building blocks in Keras.
Train and use a Transformer model for machine translation inference.
course_context: Keras Code Examples / NLP / English-to-Spanish translation with a sequence-to-sequence Transformer
notes: Finalized from the official Keras example page, which provides a complete contiguous Transformer implementation, training pipeline, and inference procedure.
